title: 🆕 New Pair: 0x428bbc820573f5d639... on robinhood
summary:
Donut Strategy turns the stock market into a playable strategy game, and $DONUT sits at the center of that economy.

Players build fleets and launch expeditions into $SPY, $NVDA, $TSLA and $MSTR sectors, each with different risk, reward and mission conditions. Instead of simply watching markets move, Donut Strategy turns those markets into places you can explore, raid and compete around.

$DONUT is the fuel that powers those expeditions.

As more players launch missions, more $DONUT is used. Every expedition follows the same fixed split: 70% of the fuel spent is permanently burned, 20% is routed to the dividend pool and 10% goes to the treasury. That means game activity is directly connected to the token economy rather than $DONUT existing separately from the product.

The thesis behind $DONUT is simple: if more people play, more fuel is needed. If more fuel is spent, more $DONUT is removed from supply.

And the game is designed to keep changing with the market itself. US trading hours affect the experience, while After-Hours Raids introduce different risk and reward conditions when traditional markets are closed.

Expeditions can return with Stock Fragments, Engine Parts, Plasma Cannons and other resources used throughout the game, creating a progression loop around launching missions, building stronger fleets and taking on higher-risk sectors.

Most tokens launch first and search for utility later.

Donut Strategy is building the opposite way: start with a game people can actually play, then make $DONUT the fuel layer that powers its economy.

If Donut Strategy grows, $DONUT is designed to grow with the activity happening inside it.

The game exists. The economy has a reason to exist. The rest comes down to how large the fleet becomes.

$DONUT is a speculative utility token. Some onchain and oracle features described in the roadmap are still under development. DYOR.
